section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study (Study 1) examining the psychometric properties of the Dutch BAS-2 in Dutch-speaking female undergraduates from the Netherlands. The study found a one-dimensional factor structure consistent with international samples, acceptable internal consistency, and a significant negative correlation between BAS-2 scores and BMI, supporting the construct validity of the Dutch BAS-2 across cultures. Key limitations include the exclusive recruitment of female undergraduates, limiting generalizability to men and broader age ranges.
